# sonarqube_user_token (Ephemeral Resource)

A short-lived token, generated when Terraform opens it and revoked when the run ends. It is never stored in state or plan files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A token that exists only for the duration of one Terraform run, for example
# to configure another provider. It is never written to state or plan files.
ephemeral "sonarqube_user_token" "run" {
  name_prefix = "terraform-run"
  type        = "USER_TOKEN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to two days ahead, as a safety net should revocation never happen.
- `login_name` (String) User owning the token. Defaults to the authenticated user.
- `name_prefix` (String) Prefix of the generated name. Defaults to `terraform-`.
- `project_key` (String) Project of a PROJECT_ANALYSIS_TOKEN.
- `type` (String) Token type, as for the resource. Defaults to USER_TOKEN.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Generated token name.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token value.
